title: Why I built a budget app
excerpt: I built a budget app and make it available for everyone
content:
Do you struggle with budgeting? With there being so many budgeting apps finding one that helps shouldn't be a problem. The problem is that most of the apps out there have to many features.

My ADHD ass gets distracted easily. I'm like that dog from UP... squirrel! So, I took it upon myself to create something that I could actually use. 

If you want to try it for yourself. You can here https://budget.ryangatchel.com

It's a very basic budgeting app that focuses on the core concepts of budgeting and savings. You can try your expenses and income for the month also.

I try and keep the menu as simple as possible. When updates are available they will be free. My plan for this is to help others who might have the same need and showcase my work.

Check it out and let me know what you think.
